READABILITY.evidence: Names are clear (buildWindowClause, validateWindowName, WindowDefinition). Each .window() method has a JSDoc block with an example, formatting was run through dprint, and the edits match the existing having/orderBy style in every dialect.

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: One shared window.ts holds all spec and validation logic. Each dialect only adds an optional windows field, a thin `(this.config.windows ??= []).push(...)` method and a single `buildWindowClause(windows)` call. Nothing is copied between dialects.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: Validation covers ntile/nthValue, preceding/following, window names and boundary ordering. But one range() from-after-to case still slips through: hidden test 'range() with from after to throws' fails, so one edge case in frame ordering is unvalidated.

C7-01-CASE1.evidence: The change is purely additive. `windows?: WindowDefinition[]` is added to all five *SelectConfig types, the same .window() exists on pg/mysql/sqlite/singlestore/gel, and windowSql is undefined when no windows are set, so existing SQL output is unchanged.
